signalValue.note: Terrance Grant flipped from Maryland to Florida on November 17, 2026. 2027 RB, DeMatha Catholic (Hyattsville, MD), 5-11 / 220. Former Bishop Gorman (Las Vegas). Chris Foster.

vaultScouting.evaluation: Grant is a compact 5-11 / 220 downhill back on DeMatha senior tape — shotgun/pistol offset, one-cut into the crease, pads down at the goal line. He sheds arm tackles and finishes DBs with a stiff-arm more than he makes people miss in a phone booth. The second gear is real once he is clean at the second level on this reel, and not yet an SEC pursuit claim. One swing/screen is on the tape; pass protection is not.
vaultScouting.comparison: Grant comps to Isiah Pacheco — 5-10 / 216 compact one-cut runner who finishes through contact, not a long-strider slasher (size-matched to Grant's 5-11 / 220; not a Florida-alum default).
vaultScouting.projection: Grant projects as Year 1 develop in Foster's room, Year 2 compete in the running back committee, with starter-upside as a compact early-down finisher — not a rotational afterthought as the ceiling.
strengths: Grant presses the hole on one cut out of shotgun/pistol offset and is already north-south — he does not dance in the backfield on this DeMatha reel.
Grant finishes through contact: pads down on short-yardage plunges and keeps his legs churning through arm tackles at the second level.
Grant's stiff-arm and compact 5-11 / 220 frame show up when a DB is the last man — he runs through the tackle rather than trying to make him miss.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Grant fits Foster's room as a north-south committee back who can grow into early-down work next to Beard, who already wins on vision and the pass game.
